apiTokens.title: API tokens
apiTokens.description: Let a script, spreadsheet, home dashboard or AI tool read your finances without your password. A token behaves as you do: it sees the same household data, including your private accounts, and nothing more.
apiTokens.created-description: Copy it now. For your security it is stored only as a hash, so this is the only time it is shown.
apiTokens.copy-failed: Could not copy the token. Select it and copy it manually.
apiTokens.name: Name
apiTokens.scope-write-hint: Write also allows reading, and covers creating and updating transactions, accounts, categories, budgets and goals. Tokens can never delete anything.
apiTokens.totp-hint: Only needed if you use two-factor authentication.
apiTokens.list-description: Only the start of each token is shown. Revoking one stops it immediately.
apiTokens.empty: You have no API tokens yet.
apiTokens.revoke-description: “{name}” will stop working immediately. Anything using it will fail until you replace it.
apiTokens.error-create: Could not create the token. Try again.
apiTokens.error-totp-required: Enter your authenticator code to create a token.
apiTokens.error-invalid-totp: That authenticator code is not valid.
apiTokens.error-session-not-fresh: Please sign in again before creating a token.
apiTokens.error-revoke: Could not revoke the token. Try again.
